contentAfterToc.text: Shopify vs WooCommerce: A Quick Overview

children: Shopify is a fully hosted, all-in-one eCommerce platform. You pay a monthly subscription, and Shopify handles everything hosting, security, updates, and infrastructure. You just built your store and are selling.

WooCommerce is a free, open-source plugin built on WordPress. It is not a standalone platform; it converts your WordPress website into a fully functional eCommerce store. You own and manage everything, from hosting to security to updates.

contentAfterToc.text: Is Shopify Payments available in India?

children: No. Shopify Payments is not available in India as of 2025. Indian merchants must use third-party payment gateways. On the Basic Shopify plan, this means paying an additional 2% transaction fee on every sale on top of the gateway’s own fee.
This Shopify India transaction fee is waived for the Shopify plan (₹6,600/month) and above.

contentAfterToc.text:
Which is cheaper, Shopify or WooCommerce, for Indian
businesses?

children: WooCommerce has a lower starting cost since the plugin itself is free. With affordable Indian hosting (₹300–₹800/month), you can run a WooCommerce store for significantly less than Shopify’s Basic plan.
However, Shopify’s predictable pricing includes hosting, security, and support, so total cost depends on your store’s scale and technical requirements.

contentAfterToc.text: Does WooCommerce support Razorpay and UPI?

children: Yes. WooCommerce has a free official Razorpay plugin that supports UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, and EMI, all the payment methods Indian customers use. There are no platform transaction fees on WooCommerce, so you only pay Razorpay’s standard gateway fee.

contentAfterToc.text: Which platform is better for SEO in India?

children: WooCommerce wins for SEO, particularly for Indian brands investing in content marketing. Built on WordPress, WooCommerce gives you full control over URL structures, meta tags, schema markup, and blog content, amplified by powerful free plugins like Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
Shopify’s SEO is solid but more restricted, with forced URL structures and limited blog functionality.

contentAfterToc.text: Can I migrate from WooCommerce to Shopify?

children: Yes, migration from WooCommerce to Shopify is possible and involves transferring products, customer data, orders, and SEO redirects. It requires careful planning to avoid data loss and ranking drops. Similarly, migrating from Shopify to WooCommerce is also achievable.
Professional migration support ensures a smooth transition without disrupting your business or SEO performance.
